cases.case_label: SVA insertion in exon 3 of PNPLA2
cases.disease: Neutral lipid storage disease with myopathy (NLSDM), subclinical
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~1.8-kb SVA retrotransposon interrupts exon 3 of PNPLA2 (homozygous; parents heterozygous). No PNPLA2 cDNA could be amplified from patient leukocytes or fibroblasts; authors suggest the polyA/GC-rich VNTR sequences block transcription.
cases.quote: RT-PCR failed to amplify the patient’s PNPLA2 mRNA.
